mentions.name: Terminalwire
mentions.description: A framework described as "Hotwire for command-line apps" that lets a web application (currently Rails) ship a CLI without building a separate API. It streams stdio, browser launch commands, and other capabilities so SaaS products can add CLIs quickly; CLI features ship server-side, avoiding the need to push client updates or maintain API compatibility, with a goal of supporting all major web frameworks. Some companies also use it as a replacement for MCP in AI stacks, reporting lower token usage and better results.
mentions.problem: Shipping CLI features normally requires pushing updates to client installs and keeping them compatible with your API.
mentions.audience: Teams building SaaS products who want to ship a CLI quickly
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://terminalwire.com

It’s “Hotwire for command-line apps”, meaning you can ship a CLI in a Rails app without building an API. The dream is to make it work for all major web frameworks.
